en: Colorized vintage view of a landscaped park with wide gravel paths, trees, flowerbeds, and a central fountain. Several people, including adults and children, stand on the path in the foreground. In the background are elegant buildings with red roofs partly hidden by trees. The printed title text at the top is in German and identifies the location as a park area on the Schillerpromenade in Kamenz in Saxony.
